style: stylized cinematic animation, hand-painted, dignified northeastern coastal Algonquian life

acts.title: Dawn in the wetu
beats: Nature: pre-dawn mist over salt marsh, cool lavender light, no people
Exterior wetu at first light, soft smoke, door flap glow
Host sleeping then stirring on woven mats inside wetu, amber doorway light
Host sits up slowly, rubs eyes, looks to doorway
Host lays small sticks on fire coals, embers brighten
Host at doorway silhouette, looking out at brightening marsh
Close: Host face calm, morning light on features
Wide: wetu clearing fully dawn, birds, Host steps outside

acts.title: Kin at morning
beats: Guest approaches wetu clearing on path, morning sun
Host raises hand in welcome outside wetu
Two-shot greeting, Host and Guest facing, warm light
Host gestures respect, Guest bows head slightly
Closer two-shot, both smiling gently, talking
Guest points toward family wetu area respectfully
Side walk together past wetu, soft tracking shot
They pause, look toward marsh light together

acts.title: Morning meal
beats: Wooden bowls and soft corn porridge by fire
Host offers bowl to Guest, firelight
Guest receives water gourd, drinks carefully
Both seated eating, quiet companionship
Close: hands, bowl, steam rising
Host gestures eat, Guest nods thanks
Wide meal circle, wetu behind, morning established
They finish, stand, prepare to leave clearing

acts.title: On the path
beats: Forest path entrance from clearing, dappled light
Host points the way along the trail
Guest walks ahead briefly then waits
Two walk path together under pines
Close: feet on soft path, moss
Host indicates short way vs long way with hand
Tracking shot through green corridor
They reach a fork, sky opening ahead

acts.title: Land and corn
beats: Sunny corn hills, three sisters mound garden
Host kneels by corn stalks, checks leaves
Guest watches, learns, crouches beside Host
Hands in soil, careful planting motion
Wide garden with wetu distant behind trees
Host shows Guest a ripe ear or green stalk
Both stand in field, wind moves corn
They leave garden toward forest edge

acts.title: Forest trail
beats: Deep pine forest, shafts of light
Host checks a simple snare area carefully
Guest looks up at canopy, wonder
Deer silhouette far through trees (nature)
Two walk deeper trail, quiet
Host points animal sign on ground
Close: forest textures, ferns
Trail opens toward bright water light

acts.title: At the water
beats: Salt marsh canoe on shore, silver water
Host and Guest at canoe, prepare
They fish with simple gear at marsh edge
Water reflections, reed grass motion
Two-shot by canoe, conversation
Guest lifts a small fish carefully
Wide marsh panorama, late day gold begins
They secure canoe, start return path

acts.title: Sky and weather
beats: Open sky above marsh, clouds drift
Host and Guest look upward together
Wind moves their hair and cloaks
Sun lowering, warm side light
Host gestures north/south wind idea
Wide sky dominant, small figures
Clouds color toward late afternoon

acts.title: Evening talk
beats: Wetu fire circle at dusk, copper light
Host and Guest seated by fire, discourse
Close fire embers and faces
Guest listens intently to Host news
Host finishes speaking, calm gesture
Mutual respects, gentle nods
Wide: wetu, fire, indigo sky
Night deepening, they remain by fire

acts.title: Night return
beats: Moon over salt marsh, silver path
Stars appear above pines
Guest weary, sits near wetu mats
Host welcomes rest, soft fire glow
They lay wood for night fire
Guest settles to sleep, peaceful
Host silhouette watching embers
Final wide: wetu under stars, night holds
